subject.title: [Feature]: Option to force-prepend an opening <think> tag for local reasoning models

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class default-off synthetic `<think>` opener option, or should missing delimiter handling remain provider/model-owned through params, catalog metadata, and plugin hooks?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds config/default and output-format behavior that OpenClaw policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
options.body: Keep the issue open for maintainer review and use existing provider params/catalog metadata unless maintainers confirm those seams cannot cover the observed models.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core option
options.body: Add one documented default-off config path, wire it through runner/subscriber params, and prove streaming plus final-message behavior with native-tag and no-tag cases.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Reject frontend-side delimiter synthesis and ask reporters to use provider/model prompt or request settings instead.

recommendation.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for maintainer review and use existing provider params/catalog metadata unless maintainers confirm those seams cannot cover the observed models.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer-facing comment and current file history both point to the config and embedded-agent surfaces Peter recently maintained.
